name: website_https
description: Ansible playbook that installs and configures Apache HTTPS on Ubuntu, including TLS materials, a virtual host, site and SSL module enablement, and service restart.

name: poodle_fix
description: Ansible remediation playbook that restricts Apache SSL protocols to TLS 1.2 and notifies Apache and SSH service handlers.

name: chef_automate_bootstrap
description: Deploys Chef Automate and Chef Infra Server, then provisions a Chef user, organization, and generated PEM credentials.

name: chef_server_bootstrap
description: Deploys Chef Infra Server and provisions a Chef user, organization, and generated PEM credentials.

name: verification_controls
description: Chef InSpec controls that verify HTTPS availability, TLS protocol settings, and SSH root-login compliance.
